xmb_art: the kit's own XMB from 0.4.0: icon (ICON0.PNG), icon video (ICON1.PMF), background (PIC1.PNG) and theme (SND0.AT3) by BananaSplitGamer (beta issue #205), on Jussimir's decision of 15/11/2026; only these exact sections are allowed (tools/pbp.py KIT_XMB, release_policy.json reviewed_xmb_art). quality_approval: Version 0.4.0, the first open beta (the 0.3.2 candidate renamed), prepared on Jussimir's direction to ship the Brightness option, the XMB icon and background made from the player's own disc, the way back to Bayview after Street X and Drift events (#195), the post-race menus that no longer pause (#154, #191), the drift's winner scene, lost points and slip angle (#191), the World Map's heading arrow (#201), the outrun's orange arrow (#186), the PS2 disc's menu and street sounds at their pitch (#158), the menu sounds of #174 and #181, the career's garage, resume spot, race markers, prologue and stage order (#199, #184, #198, #180, #202), division by zero no longer stopping the PSP (#148), the Options Debug page with the Debug Overlay switch, the Final Race (#204), the shops' welcome (#188), Open Bayview (#203), the Dyno and its test runs (#144), All Cars in Customize (#173), the Body Shop layout (#29), the city, HUD and car visuals (#167, #182, #183, #192), the GPS and menu sounds (#106, #176, #178) and the fixes integrated since 0.3.1, with the same rules as 0.3.1, once it passes PPSSPP; its battery is 0.3.2-rc.2's plus the Debug page and the version change. Tests ran on this executable. Not a final release, physical PSP-1000, all-device, full-game, visual-fidelity or stable-30-fps approval.
known_issues: No physical PSP-1000 has run this build: the compact profile was measured on a PSP-3000 limited to the PSP-1000 memory and in PPSSPP set to the PSP-1000.
Stable 30 fps throughout the game is not yet established (University Hill and the densest city areas drop frames in both profiles).
On PSP-1000, the city can pause to load right after the World Map turns the GPS on (seen in PPSSPP; it happens on 0.3.0 too).
Full-career completion and all save/reload paths are not qualified.
Drag 4401 rivals may become stuck in repeated recovery.
Drift audio cuts/clicks, pause sound and braking sound still need tester confirmation.
Custom dyno and special presets use the earlier handling path; collisions retain port adaptations.
Materials, visibility, doors, movies and all audio/camera combinations need broader testing.
The original US PS2 disc image has not been independently verified; PAL and other revisions are refused.
Menu camera height on the stick, shop rooms' own lighting and the Body Shop part browser are still open.
reference_scope: Full ISO conversions (Xbox and PS2) by this kit's native generator on macOS arm64; the card's EBOOT.PBP is the kit's, with its own XMB, for both sources. Output identity does not establish gameplay quality.
data_compatibility: Install the complete output of this generator (update a 0.2.x, 0.3.0 or 0.3.1 folder with the same ISO, or generate into a new folder). 0.4.0 changes EBOOT.PBP (now with the XMB art of your own disc) and converted data (the outrun arrow, the GPS models, the HUD, the city and the cars, the career data, the Dyno screens, the music, and on the PS2 disc the menu and street sounds); copying only the EBOOT leaves old data that this executable does not expect. Saves move to version 16 the first time 0.4.0 writes them. Do not mix Xbox and PS2 output.
